purpose: one fixed exploratory hypothesis, not a parameter search
decision: BUY or NO_TRADE; missing/uncertain calibration means NO_TRADE
trend1h: EMA12>EMA26, SMA21>SMA50, close>SMA21, SMA21 now>SMA21 three closed hours earlier
pullback5m: distance below highest high of previous 12 closed 5m bars, in [0.5,2.5] ATR5m; latest 5m bar green and closes above previous close
recovery1m: green bar and close>previous high, no RSI/MACD extra votes
protection: absolute stop=min(low of last six closed 5m bars -0.1 ATR5m, signal price-1.5 ATR5m); target=signal price+2 ATR5m; max stop distance 2%; max holding 60m
risk: max net estimated stop loss 0.5% of account equity; existing max exposure/slots/budget/daily loss retained; no averaging down

calibration.sampleRule: structural candidates before economic gate; nonoverlapping 60m labels, per period; all labels contiguous, complete and prior to evaluation
calibration.expectedReturnRule: lower 95% day-block bootstrap bound on mean 60m gross close return must exceed modeled MARKET round-trip break-even +0.0005
calibration.potentialRule: 25th percentile of observed 60m MFE must exceed round-trip break-even +0.0005; MFE is not treated as realized exit PnL

oosPolicy: audit workspace for prior usage, freeze code/config/calibration hashes after technical checks, then download and evaluate candidate final period once; no changes after observing outcomes
zeroTrades: means abstention or insufficient evidence, never proof of profitability
operationalPolicy: all accounts remain paused, no approvals, no live adapter, no production balance/inventory writes
